en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the words of Lutas [11:78] These are my daughters (nation’s daughters)- they are purer for you. Heasws said: ‘Heas presented to them for the marriage’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah from Ya’qub bin Shu’ayb who has said the following: “About the words of Lot, ‘These are my daughters and they are cleaner and pure,’ [11:78] abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He offered them for marriage.’”
